note: Pre-registered BEFORE any cover/payout backtest was computed. Same rules as heartbeat-params: never edited, a change is a new version and every version's result is published.
halt_rule: at the end of hour t, a halt is confirmed if the outflow count over the trailing 24 hours is < 0.10 x the median of the 24-hour totals of the previous 28 days (and that median >= 10)
why_daily: daily totals stay usable for quiet wallets (WazirX ~83 outflows/day) where hourly medians are below 4
payout_time: halt confirmed + challenge window, if the halt rule still holds at the end of the window
live_extra_condition: k = 3 distinct stuck-withdrawal zkTLS proofs in the window (live only; history has no such proofs, so backtests use the on-chain rule alone and say so)
baseline_to_compare: Nexus Mutual Custody Cover: claimable after withdrawals are halted for >= 100 days (nexusmutual.io risk index)
result_metrics: false payouts in the same control windows as the heartbeat (must be 0)
